scan.title: Scan masjid QR
scan.hint: Point your camera at the QR code on the masjid poster.
scan.invalid: This is not a {app} QR code

permission.title: Allow the camera
permission.body: The camera is used only to read the masjid’s QR code. Nothing is recorded or sent.

denied.title: The camera is blocked
denied.body: To scan, allow the camera for this app in your browser or phone settings. Or enter the code printed under the QR.

unavailable.title: Scanning isn’t available here
unavailable.body: Enter the 8-character code printed under the QR on the masjid poster.

busy.title: The camera couldn’t start
busy.body: Close other apps that use the camera and try again.

code.title: Enter masjid code
code.body: Type the 8-character code printed under the QR on the masjid poster.
code.label: Masjid code
code.invalid: This code isn’t valid. Check it and try again.

preview.limit: You follow {max} masjids, the most allowed. Unfollow one to add another.

landing.title: Follow masjid
landing.notFoundBody: This link or code doesn’t match any masjid. It may be mistyped, or the masjid is no longer listed.
landing.iosBody: Open {app} from your Home Screen, tap Scan, then choose “Enter code instead” and type:
landing.iosNoApp: Don’t have the app yet? Add it to your Home Screen first.
landing.iosHere: Use it here in Safari instead
